colormaps.name: fire
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_L3 — perceptually-uniform black → red → yellow → white. Alternative to inferno with cleaner luminance ramp.
colormaps.citation: Kovesi (2015), 'Good Colour Maps: How to Design Them', arXiv:1509.03700

colormaps.name: kbc
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_L7 — black → blue → cyan. PU alternative to ice/oslo with brighter mid-range.

colormaps.name: bgy

colormaps.name: bmw
colormaps.description: Kovesi blue → magenta → white. Distinctive hue path; good for fields where red/yellow palettes are reserved for other channels.

colormaps.name: bkr

colormaps.name: bjy

colormaps.name: cjm
colormaps.description: Kovesi isoluminant diverging cyan ↔ magenta through jade (L=75). Use for signed data overlaid on grayscale imagery — luminance stays constant so the underlying structure reads through. Not a general-purpose diverging map (luminance discrimination beats hue).

colormaps.name: cjo
